name: Predator Free Communities Funding

funder.name: Predator Free NZ Trust (with Simplicity Foundation)

summary: Funding for neighbourhood backyard trapping groups in New Zealand towns and suburbs to buy approved traps, monitoring gear and building supplies, plus volunteer engagement costs. No charity status needed.
reporting: A brief progress report is required, and funding should be used within 12 to 18 months.

calls.label: Current round
calls.recurring: Rounds are generally in March/April and July/August each year.

applicant_types.quote: Any community with a plan to control predators in residential backyards throughout their suburb or town can apply for funding. You don't need to be a registered charity or conservation organisation.

access.quote: we select outstanding predator free backyard communities from around New Zealand and give them funding for trapping equipment.

window.quote: Funding rounds are generally in March/April and July/August

amount.quote: Funded groups receive between $1,000 and $5,000 based on need and size of the community.

reporting.quote: A brief progress report is required. Allocated funding should be used within 12-18 months.

geography.quote: we select outstanding predator free backyard communities from around New Zealand
